item.title: [+1] US trade deal on a steady keel: Piyush Goyal on Sitharaman’s ‘plateaued’ remark | ETSA 2026
item.description:
Signal: trade deal or tariff relief for India (India). 8 reports from DD News, Traders Union, The Economic Times and 5 more. Related: “Bangladesh calls for India to lift ‘anti-dumping’ duties in trade talks”. Turn: earlier readings (5 Oct) pointed the other way.

Agri & fertilisers: mild tailwind (+1) — Farm exports gain access

Why it matters: Lower tariffs or a trade deal open markets for Indian exporters and attract investment into export manufacturing.

Market gauges: Growth outlook +1, Rupee +1, Equities (Nifty & Sensex) +1

Confidence: medium · horizon: months

item.title: [+1] Black Sea grain exports crater amid widening maritime war
item.description:
Signal: higher global food prices (global). 2 reports from DD News, Splash 24/7. Related: “Retail inflation rises to 4.38% in June; food inflation at 5.32%”. Ongoing: also reported on 1 of the previous 7 days (first 4 Oct).

Agri & fertilisers: mild tailwind (+1) — Export prices firm

Why it matters: Dearer world food, edible oil and fertiliser raise India's import costs and food inflation.

Market gauges: Inflation outlook −1, Fiscal & trade balance −1

Confidence: medium · horizon: months
